newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Mar 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Mar 20.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Bangladesh and Indian officials on Friday will finalise the schedule of the repatriation of Bangladeshi tribal refugees from the Indian state of Tripura.
Commonwealth Secretary General Emeka Anyaku arrives in Dhaka on Thursday on a two-day visit to Bangladesh.
Bangladesh will receive $57 million as grant aid from the UN Development Programme for eight new projects.
Iranian Foreign Minister Dr Ali Akbar Velayeti arrives in Dhaka on Thursday on a two-day visit to Bangladesh.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has asked the ministry of health to take step to set up more hospitals for children.
The government on Wednesday appointed lawyers as state defence for the 14 absconding accused in the murder of the independence leader Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.
BHP Minerals, an U.S.-Australian mutinational that recently struck a coal in northern Bangladesh, has estimated the deposit at 300 million metric tons.

A high-powered team of Energy Ministry officials and Petrobangla experts will be heading for Britain and the United States early next week in connection with biddings for the country's fifteen oil and gas exploration blocks.
